item.title: Task Force Iron Gate: Why US cannot seal Iran’s land trade routes
item.description: Iran's neighbors are lining up to expand trade and transportation ties with Tehran even as the US unveils Task Force Iron Gate, seeking to restrict Iran's land-based commerce and economic connections.

item.title: Iran, Uzbekistan agree to ease transit and revive regional corridors
item.description: Roads minister says a joint committee will be formed to restore corridor links between the two countries and the wider region.

item.title: Iran tells UN Security Council to stop reversing roles of 'aggressor and victim'
item.description: Iran’s ambassador to the UN has slammed Western members of the Security Council for their double standards, demanding the US immediately end its war of aggression and lift its illegal blockade.

item.title: IRGC Navy: Two oil tankers explode, catch fire after hitting mines
item.description: The Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) Navy announced that two oil tankers attempting a covert, unauthorized transit through the southern Strait of Hormuz have exploded.

item.title: Iran fully prepared for ‘painful operations’ against enemies beyond the region: IRGC deputy chief
item.description: The IRGC deputy chief reaffirms Iran’s full readiness to launch powerful and painful military operations against its enemies, including beyond the region.

item.title: Lebanon’s Grand Shia Mufti: Iran, Resistance shape regional order after historic US defeat
item.description: Lebanon’s Grand Shia Mufti says Iran is pivotal to shaping West Asia’s future security and political equations, describing the US war of aggression against the Islamic Republic as a historic defeat for Washington.

item.title: Three World Cups, countless memories and an emotional goodbye: Saman Ghoddos’s Team Melli journey
item.description: Saman Ghoddos bids farewell to Team Melli after nine years, three World Cups and two Asian Cups, with 41 appearances, valuable contributions and an enduring bond with Iranian fans.

item.title: Massive explosion as violating LPG carrier hits naval mine east of Strait of Hormuz: IRGC
item.description: An LPG carrier caught fire east of the Strait of Hormuz after striking a naval mine as the violating carrier tried to pass through an unauthorized route, says the IRGC.

item.title: Iranians bid farewell to 350 unidentified martyrs of Iraqi imposed war on Iran
item.description: A mass funeral procession is held in the Iranian capital of Tehran for 110 unidentified martyrs of Iraq's 1980-88 war under former dictator Saddam Hussein on neighboring Iran.

item.title: Iraq, Turkey, Pakistan defy US pressure to close borders with Iran: Report
item.description: The US has failed to persuade Iraq, Pakistan and Turkey to close their borders with Iran, undermining Washington’s efforts to restrict Tehran’s land trade routes, according to a report.

item.title: ‘Unacceptable’: Iran rejects UK’s claims of involvement in violent, espionage acts
item.description: Iran dismisses as “unacceptable” British authorities’ accusations about the Islamic Republic’s involvement in acts of violence and espionage activities in the UK.

item.title: IRGC destroys US early-warning radar in Bahrain after attack on Sirik telecom tower
item.description: The IRGC said in a statement on Friday morning that the operation was carried out in direct response to an aerial aggression by the enemy against a telecommunications tower in Sirik.

item.title: German cities witness climate protests amid COP31 summit
item.description: Climate activists protested in several German cities on November 13, demanding stronger climate action and environmental justice during the COP31 summit in Türkiye.

item.title: Fuel price hikes spark protests in Central African Republic
item.description: Hundreds of people protest fuel price hikes and demand the release of detained activists in the Central African Republic.

item.title: Unprecedented protests by high school principals in France against violence
item.description: School principals rally against the violence they have been subjected to since the beginning of the student movement in France.
